title: BLE gateway
description: Bridges BLE devices to signalk-server's BLE provider API. Which devices are read, and how, is configured on the server - not here.

keys.name: enabled
keys.title: Enabled
keys.description: Master switch for the BLE gateway.

keys.name: active_scan
keys.title: Active scan
keys.description: Request scan responses (more data per device, more airtime). Leave off on the ESP32-P4: active scan needs the C6 co-processor to transmit SCAN_REQ over SDIO, which is unreliable and can silence advertisements entirely.

keys.name: scan_win_ms
keys.title: Scan window
keys.description: Listening time per interval. Must not exceed the interval; window/interval is the duty cycle.

keys.name: post_int_ms
keys.title: POST interval
keys.description: The longest buffered advertisements wait before they are forwarded to the server, and the wait after a failed POST. A full batch goes out at once.

keys.name: status_int_ms
keys.title: Status interval
keys.description: How often a status frame goes out on the control WebSocket.

keys.name: max_pend_ads
keys.title: Advertisement buffer
keys.description: Advertisements held between POSTs. When full the oldest are dropped and counted, so a slow or absent server cannot exhaust memory. The buffer is one contiguous block of about 128 B per entry, allocated at start: where the heap cannot spare it the gateway logs a warning and uses a smaller buffer rather than failing to start, so on a small-RAM board the effective size may be well below this.

keys.name: control_ws
keys.title: Control WebSocket
keys.description: Enables hello/status and GATT commands. With this off the gateway still forwards advertisements over HTTP, which is all that beacon-style devices (Ruuvi, Victron) need.

keys.name: max_gatt_sess
keys.title: Max GATT connections
keys.description: Concurrent GATT connections advertised to the server. The Bluedroid GATT client supports at most 3.
